body_text:
Let $U\subseteq\mathbb{C}$ be open and let $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$.
The function is complex differentiable at $z_0\in U$ if the
limit $\lim_{h\to0}(f(z_0+h)-f(z_0))/h$ exists and has the same
value for all complex directions of approach. It is holomorphic
on $U$ if it is complex differentiable at every point of $U$.
